title.narrative: Acceleration towards achieving zero Indigenous Malaria in Bhutan - Bhutan (01-Jul-2018-30-Jun-2021)

description.narrative: Bhutan, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Royal Government of Bhutan (MOH)This program has the following goals: To achieve zero indigenous malaria in Bhutan by end of 2018 and obtain WHO-malaria free certification by 2020.. The objectives of this program are: Active Foci of malaria eliminated by end of 2018. Resurgence of malaria prevented by end of 2018. Zero malaria death achieved and sustained from 2017. Health system and community system strengthened to sustain malaria elimination
